allow: PowerShell($src = 'modeditor/src/renderer/assets/textures'; $biomes = @{ tierra='tierra.png'; arena='arena.png'; 'road-up'='road-up.png'; 'road-down-left'='road-down-left.png'; 'road-x'='road-x.png'; metal='metal.png'; plaza='plaza.png'; casa='metal.png'; rascacielos='metal.png' }; $faces = @\('top','side','capital','base','bottom'\); foreach \($b in $biomes.Keys\) { $dir = Join-Path $src $b; if \(-not \(Test-Path $dir\)\) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }; foreach \($f in $faces\) { Copy-Item -Path \(Join-Path $src $biomes[$b]\) -Destination \(Join-Path $dir "$f.png"\) -Force } }; Get-ChildItem $src -Directory | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.Name\)/: $\(\(Get-ChildItem $_.FullName\).Count\) files" })
